column1: # VMD frames are inclusive and use 30 fps. The sampler outputs 60 fps; * means source maximum.
# mode describes downstream intent. Sampling always uses absolute native seeking with looping disabled.
# source_mask comes from CustomSteve animation.json. Full source bones are solved before any target mask.
# body.sneak_idle/body.sneak_walk. These are authored crouched cycles, not stand-to-crouch transitions.
# body.swim is the generic water state; body.swimming selects active/visual swimming strokes.
# upper_body.hold_bow_up and bow_draw_up. Frame 480 is a long hold tail with only a tiny left-arm drift.
# Frame 23 is the stable drawn pose in the 10-23 hold window; it is deliberately not a new draw cycle.
# Single-frame arm overlays; applying them as whole-body movement would overwrite locomotion.
# attack_sword is a candidate generic stick/tool swing, not a sword-specific combo.
# CustomSteve dispatches regular held items separately; keep both candidates for explicit item policy.
